## Formulated Theoretical Frameworks

1. **Tri-Vector Growth Engine**: Uniting Technical Search Physics, Unit Economic Capital Allocation, and Human Psychological Persuasion into a single mathematical system.
2. **Global Marketing Excellence Framework (GMEF-5)**: Algorithmic Mastery, Capital Velocity, Technical Code-First Fluency, GEO Knowledge Grounding, and Deterministic Commercial RevOps.
3. **Zero-Click Conversion Protocol**: Engineering semantic brand entity authority to win definitive AI answer citations in Google Gemini, Claude 3.7, ChatGPT Search, and Perplexity when searchers never click a traditional link.
4. **Lean MarTech Architecture**: Replacing bloated, unintegrated enterprise SaaS subscriptions with resilient first-party server-side Python and BigQuery pipelines.
5. **Information Gain Divergence Ratio**: Quantifying content defensibility using Shannon Entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to outrank commodity AI search summaries.
